common.tagline: Multilingual AI concierge & booking agent for small stays

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with your property manager account.
login.magicLinkSent: We sent a sign-in link to your email. Please check your inbox.
login.genericError: Something went wrong while signing in. Please try again.

dashboard.comingSoon: This screen will be built in an upcoming phase.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.description: The AI only states facts registered here. Anything else is handed over to staff.
knowledge.question: Title (typical question)
knowledge.contentHint: Write the facts to tell guests. Be exact about times, prices and locations.
knowledge.deleteConfirm: Delete this item? This cannot be undone.

errors.generic: Could not save. Please try again.

playground.title: Chat playground
playground.description: Try the AI as a guest would. Conversations here are excluded from metrics.
playground.placeholder: Ask like a guest (한국어 · 日本語 · English · 中文)
playground.empty: No messages yet. Send a question to start.
playground.mockNotice: AI_MODE=mock: running a rule-based mock AI, not real Claude responses.

email.subject: [StayTalk] {property}: {reason}
email.intro: A guest conversation at {property} was handed over to staff.
email.question: Guest message
email.footer: This email was sent automatically by StayTalk.
email.bookingIntro: {property} has a new booking request. Please review and approve or decline it.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Review guest conversations and reply directly when needed. Replies are translated into the guest's language.
inbox.question: Guest question
inbox.replyHint: Write in {language}; it is translated into the guest's language. The original is kept.
inbox.aiPaused: Staff is handling this conversation; the AI will not reply.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.widgetDescription: Paste this code right before '</body>' on your property's website.
settings.allowedOriginsHint: One site URL per line (e.g. https://my-guesthouse.com). The widget won't open on sites not listed here.
settings.lineDescription: Enter your Messaging API channel details from the LINE Developers console and register the webhook URL below.
settings.keepHint: Leave blank to keep the saved value.
settings.credentialsRequired: The channel secret and access token are required the first time.
settings.ownerOnly: Only owner accounts can change settings.

rooms.title: Rooms & inventory
rooms.description: Manage room types and per-date inventory and rates. Dates without settings use the defaults (total rooms, base rate).
rooms.nameRequired: Enter a name in at least one language.
rooms.csvHint: Columns: date,room_type,available,rate,closed — room_type is a room type name or id. Blank means default.
rooms.csvErrors: {count} errors — fix them and upload again.

csvErrorCodes.invalid_available: Rooms must be a whole number ≥ 0
csvErrorCodes.invalid_rate: Rate must be a whole number ≥ 0

bookings.title: Booking requests
bookings.description: Booking requests collected by the AI. Approving sends the guest a confirmation automatically.

errors.no_availability: Not enough inventory to approve. Check inventory or decline.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Real guest conversations only (test conversations excluded). Dates use the property's local time.
metrics.openNow: Open now: {ai} with AI · {escalated} waiting for staff
metrics.usageWarning: This month's usage passed 80% of the limit.
metrics.usageOver: The monthly limit is reached; new questions go to staff.

unanswered.title: Questions the AI couldn't answer
unanswered.description: Add them to the knowledge base and the AI will answer next time.

legal.draft: Placeholder page. Replace with legally reviewed text before launch.
legal.retentionNote: Guest conversation logs are masked 90 days after the last message.

onboarding.title: Property setup
onboarding.description: Four steps to get the AI concierge ready.
onboarding.name: Property name
onboarding.ownerOnly: Only owner accounts can change property details.
onboarding.roomsHint: Add the room types you offer. Per-date inventory and rates can be set later under Rooms & inventory.
onboarding.knowledgeHint: Questions guests often ask. Fill in only what you know; empty questions are skipped. The AI only states what is written here.
onboarding.widgetHint: Paste this code into your website and register the sites where the widget may appear.
onboarding.done: All set. Try the AI in the chat playground.

checkin_time.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?

self_checkin.question: How do I check in if I arrive late?
self_checkin.hint: e.g. self check-in after 22:00, how the door code is sent

luggage.question: Can I store my luggage?
luggage.hint: e.g. free before check-in and after check-out until 18:00

wifi.question: Is there Wi-Fi?
wifi.hint: e.g. free in all rooms; password in the room guide

parking.question: Is there parking?
parking.hint: e.g. no parking; public lot 5 minutes away

amenities.question: Are towels and toiletries provided?
amenities.hint: e.g. towels, shampoo, hair dryer provided

pets.question: Are pets allowed?
pets.hint: e.g. no pets except assistance dogs

airport.question: How do I get here from the airport?
airport.hint: e.g. train route, transfers and total time

nearby_food.question: Any restaurants nearby?
nearby_food.hint: e.g. market 5 minutes away, local favourites

cancellation.question: What is the cancellation policy?
cancellation.hint: e.g. full refund up to 7 days before; 50% 3–6 days before

payment.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
